d.ko: Take control of a Soviet locomotive and embark on a dangerous journey along the world's longest railway line. Face mafia rivals, bandits, wild animals, constant breakdowns, severe frosts, hunger, and... a hangover. How far will you get before your supplies run out?
d.en: Take control of a Soviet locomotive and embark on a dangerous journey along the world's longest railway line. Face mafia rivals, bandits, wild animals, constant breakdowns, severe frosts, hunger, and... a hangover. How far will you get before your supplies run out?
d.zh: 开着一辆苏联造机车，顺着全球最长的铁路线开始一段充满危险的旅程。面对黑帮对头、土匪、野生动物、不断的故障、天寒地冻、饥饿乃至……宿醉。补给用完前还能走多远？
